name: intentlove-shop
description: IntentLove Shop - Complete e-commerce platform with frontend, backend, and admin dashboard

scripts.dev:frontend: cd site frontend && npm run dev
scripts.dev:admin: cd site frontend/admin-dashboard && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:creative && npm run build:admin
scripts.build:frontend: cd site frontend && npm run build
scripts.build:admin: cd site frontend/admin-dashboard && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:creative && npm run install:admin
scripts.start:production: npm run install:all && npm run build && cd creative-card-scribe-main/server && npm run start:production
scripts.stop: echo 'Use Ctrl+C to stop all services'
scripts.clean: npm run clean:node_modules && npm run clean:dist && npm run clean:build
